== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The original front and reverse are collector 40a and 40b. The December-2006 official sheet uses 40 for both. The independently archived Players Committee pair was captured 16 December 2007. Its front matches the dated later front. Its reverse says “May ▼ a marker site” without naming a phase, while the dated later reverse names the deploy phase. Ordinary site deployment rules still require the owner’s deploy phase. The One Rule separately limits a singular action when the card names a time frame. The unqualified wording can allow additional eligible separate pulls during that same deploy phase. The gallery capture does not establish its first issue or precedence.
